name: Mesu Neko Yuugi
source:
Our guy finds employees for people. Today he has a new female partner and a mission to find a missing girl plus a secretary in a company. Their excuse for being there is that they are sexual harassment detectives. What a joke, soon the guy has harassed most of the girls that work there. Good thing for him too, because with those girls' help, he will find out the funny going ons of this company.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公从事人才中介工作。今天，他有了一名新的女性搭档，同时接到任务，要寻找一名失踪少女，以及某家公司的秘书。两人潜入公司的借口，是自称调查职场性骚扰的侦探。真是个笑话——没过多久，主人公自己便骚扰了公司里的大多数女员工。不过，这对他反而是件好事，因为在这些少女帮助下，他将查明公司中种种荒唐怪事的真相。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
